name: Gatalenta
description: Gatalenta was a planet located in the galaxy. By the third Galactic War, Gatalentans were known for their tea and their long tradition of supporting the Jedi. Gatalenta was considered a beautiful planet by Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun, a general in the Galactic Republic.
